config.zongheng_railway.areaGenerationRa: Chance that a region generates a railway network.
Only used when "Generate railway everywhere" is off. 0 = never, 1 = always.
config.zongheng_railway.connectAcrossReg: Joins the railway networks of adjacent regions at their shared border.
Off = every 4096x4096 region keeps its own separate network.
config.zongheng_railway.doubleTrackEnabl: Lays two parallel tracks instead of a single centre line.
config.zongheng_railway.enableTrackSpawn: Whether the track spawner block is usable.
config.zongheng_railway.generateRailwayE: When off, generation is limited by the probability and the region radius below.
config.zongheng_railway.generateTrackSpa: Whether track spawner blocks appear in the world.
config.zongheng_railway.maxRegionDistanc: How many regions away from the world origin may still generate railways.
Only used when "Generate railway everywhere" is off. One region is 4096 blocks.
config.zongheng_railway.placeTracksUsing: Place rails with the track spawner
On = rails are placed when the track spawner runs.
Off = rails are placed directly during world generation.
config.zongheng_railway.planTimeoutSecon: How long chunk generation may wait for a region plan before letting the chunk generate without railway.
0 = wait forever (the original behaviour). Planning still finishes in the background, so the rails appear when you come back.
config.zongheng_railway.preheatAroundPla: When a new railway region is entered, plan the regions around it in the background.
Planning only - no rails are placed inside chunks that are not loaded yet.
config.zongheng_railway.preheatRadius.to: How many rings of regions around the current one get pre-planned. 1 = 3x3 regions (12288x12288 blocks).
Only used when "Pre-plan neighbouring regions" is on. 0 = only the current region.
config.zongheng_railway.title: ZongHeng Railway
config.zongheng_railway.trackSpacing.too: Distance in blocks between the two parallel tracks.
Only used when "Double track" is on. 3 keeps both tracks inside the narrow bridge templates.
